final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS n FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rating AS rating, s1.n AS n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.total AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.rating, s3.n, s3.share, s3.share - s4.avg_share AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.avg_share) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM s5
